attacks.name: Sonic Blast
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Suppressive|: Before |!damage| is dealt, for each |!wild| in the attack roll, the defender loses 1 |!power|.
|!critical| |!wild| |*Stun|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender suffers the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Sonic Shockwave
steps: After the Range Tool is placed for this attack, destroy all |!size| 2 or smaller interactive terrain features it overlaps.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

superPowers.name: Black Market Entrepreneur (Affiliation: Criminal Syndicate)
superPowers.body: When an allied character is Dazed or KO'd, after the effect is resolved, |*Klaw| may Advance |!movement_small|.

superPowers.name: Reconstitute Form
superPowers.body: This character removes up to 2 |!damage| from itself. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Soundwave Barrier
superPowers.body: When an enemy character ends its Activation within |!range| 3 of this character, it may use this superpower. This character may Push the enemy character Away |!movement_small|.

superPowers.name: Absorb Vibrations
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an enemy |!physical| or |!energy| attack or makes a Dodge roll, after the effect is resolved, it gains 1 |!power|.|\|Additionally, this character cannot be Pushed or Advanced by effects of |!energy| attacks or enemy superpowers.
